 The smartest negotiation rule you’ve never heard of
Hi Sara,
Here’s a deal-making rule that sounds strange until you try it:
Accept 75 percent of the redlines.
Not because they’re perfect. Not because you love them. But because it moves the deal forward. And that’s the whole point.
When the seller’s attorney sends back edits, you don’t need to fight over every comma. Most changes are small. A few actually matter. The trick is knowing which is which.
Here’s how I break it down with clients:
If it’s a business term like how long the seller stays on, the client needs to get on a call and figure it out.
If it’s a legal point like indemnification or liability, let the lawyers work it out privately.
You save time, legal fees, and your sanity. 
Deals don’t fall apart because of one big disagreement. They fall apart when nobody lets go of the little stuff.
If you’re in the thick of one, reply and tell me where you’re stuck. Or check out Deal Academy for the playbook I use every day.
Here’s to progress over perfection,
Sara Sharp
Partner, SK&S Law Group
Founder of Deal Academy
